lastCompletedStory.title: Vendorizacao com escrita em staging e promocao atomica fail-closed

nextStoryContext: vendorCoss is synchronous and accepts an injected fetchFiles function returning { relPath, content } entries. It writes into a random sibling staging directory, calls verify(staging), promotes with renameSync only after approval, and removes staging in finally. Replacing an already-existing non-empty destination remains outside this story's acceptance criteria and should be resolved with the real re-executable vendor flow.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Current Node.js docs confirm mkdtempSync returns the created sibling directory path, renameSync performs the promotion rename, and rmSync supports recursive force cleanup.
